decisions.reason: The publication impact is already fully represented by the existing message-158 MODIFY requiring relevant images and internal links before publication.
The source makes internal links a publication prerequisite, and the existing message-158 MODIFY already records required_before_publication as true.
The source makes images a publication prerequisite, and the existing message-158 MODIFY already records images_required_before_publication as true.
The conditional authorization to publish does not change the requirement to produce three SEO blog articles.
The publication prerequisites do not alter the client-confirmed keyword targets for the blog articles.
The source concerns conditions for publishing blog content and does not change the website SEO keyword target set.
The source does not modify approved webpage replacement terms or their content-replacement scope.
The requirement to include keyword search-volume data is unaffected by the blog publication prerequisites.
The conditional publication authorization does not change homepage H1 or heading-hierarchy optimization.
The source does not change the requirement to optimize the website's meta title and description.
The blog publication gate has no effect on backlink quantity, types, or distribution.
The source refers to adding relevant images to blog articles before publication, not adding ALT attributes to existing website images.
